_about: HKBU SCIE1007 coursework video: settings of the phone-footage pipeline. Changing a value makes the steps that read it run again.

audio._enhance_model_note: picked 11-12 by the manager from round 2 in 01_两处对比.md (most script words heard, least change to the voice, gaps keep faint room tone); the director can still overrule by ear

ident._llm_assist_note: true = ask the text model (keys in _env/keys.env) about the unsure items; the rules still decide, the model's opinion is stored next to them

video._backdrop_note: placeholder beige, the director has not picked the colour yet

backdrop_cells._note: 11-12 director idea: the end-card hand-drawn cell collisions (fusion/end, w5cells2_sim.py + bl_w5cells2.py) behind on-camera clips only, a new seed per clip, length = clip length; not for the whole film. Sample (D, slow vs normal) waits until rendering resumes

video._restore_note: director, 11-13: B's phone smears the picture (blotchy skin, soft edges), so B's clips go through restore.py after matting. A (iPhone 17 Pro Max front camera) is the picture-quality reference, D next, C reshoots. No one else is restored
video._matte_model_note: picked 11-12 by the manager from round 2 in 01_两处对比.md: max(RVM, BiRefNet shrunk 7 px); RVM hair, BiRefNet fills the hand holes; costs both models (~112 ms per 1080p frame on the 5080)

beauty._levels: off | light | medium; face only, never reshapes

white_balance._note: each person corrected separately onto one shared target; target set once all four have delivered
